name: Navacaprant
summary: Navacaprant is a selective κ-opioid receptor (KOR) antagonist which is under development for the treatment of major depressive disorder and bipolar depression. It was originated by BlackThorn Therapeutics and is being developed by Neumora Therapeutics. As of February 2025, navacaprant is in phase 3 clinical trials for major depressive disorder.

pharmacology.text: Navacaprant (developmental code names include BTRX-335140, BTRX-140, CYM-53093, NMRA-335140, and NMRA-140) is a selective κ-opioid receptor (KOR) antagonist which is under development for the treatment of major depressive disorder and bipolar depression.

It was originated by BlackThorn Therapeutics and is being developed by Neumora Therapeutics.

summaryZh: BTRX-335140或BTRX-140是一種研發中的選擇性的κ-阿片受體拮抗劑，用於治療重度抑鬱症。截至2020年2月，該藥物目前處於2期臨床試驗中。
summaryZhHans: BTRX-335140或BTRX-140是一种研发中的选择性的κ-阿片受体拮抗剂，用于治疗重度抑郁症。截至2020年2月，该药物目前处于2期临床试验中。

sideEffects.en: Side effects reported in trials have been mild and include headache. Because it blocks rather than activates the κ-opioid receptor, it does not cause the dysphoria that κ agonists do.
sideEffects.zh: 試驗中報告的副作用大致輕微，包括頭痛。由於它是阻斷而非活化 κ 型鴉片受體，因此不會造成 κ 促效劑那種情緒惡劣的感受。
sideEffects.zhHans: 试验中报告的副作用大致轻微，包括头痛。由于它是阻断而非活化 κ 型鸦片受体，因此不会造成 κ 促效剂那种情绪恶劣的感受。

fact.en: It blocks the κ-opioid receptor, which is the receptor that the body's own peptide dynorphin acts on, and which is thought to be involved in low mood and stress.
fact.zh: 它阻斷 κ 型鴉片受體，這是人體自身的胜肽「強度芬」作用的受體，一般認為與情緒低落和壓力有關。
fact.zhHans: 它阻断 κ 型鸦片受体，这是人体自身的胜肽「强度芬」作用的受体，一般认为与情绪低落和压力有关。
